description: Utility functions for splitting and merging recipe steps, including splitting steps by delimiters, merging steps, and handling step arrays.

methods.name: splitStepObject
methods.description: Splits a single step object into multiple step objects based on a delimiter.

methods.name: splitAllSteps
methods.description: Splits all steps in a list at a specified delimiter.

methods.name: splitStep
methods.description: Splits a specific step in a list at a specified delimiter.

methods.name: mergeStep
methods.description: Merges two steps into one, concatenating instructions and ingredients.

methods.name: mergeAllSteps
methods.description: Merges an array of steps into a single step.
